a.lede: The iOS app Oh My Hours takes a new approach to curbing screen time. It splits up your day into hour-long blocks, then shows which ones you wasted on Instagram and TikTok.
a.title: This App Brutally Shames You by Tracking How Many Hours You’ve Lost to Scrolling

b.lede: As Instagram rolls out long form videos of up to 90 minutes, the platform has an opportunity to challenge YouTube if it plays its cards right.
b.title: Watch out, YouTube — Instagram goes from short-form to 90-minute videos
